classifications.rationale: The President states an executive-branch enforcement policy and procurement objective, directing discretionary implementation rather than itself changing legal rights or requiring a specified later legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: It is the policy of the executive branch to enforce vigorously the civil rights laws of the United States

classifications.rationale: The President amends the prior contracting order to require a specified nondiscrimination clause, with the legally consequential obligation arising later through agency regulations and covered federal contracts; the accompanying regulatory instruction and savings provisions do not alter that controlling posture.
classifications.evidence: The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment
